title: Upper Paleocene to Quaternary, surface and near-surface stratigraphy of the Windsor 7.5-minute quadrangle, Aiken and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina
citation: Willoughby, R.H., Nystrom, P.G., Jr., and Price, L.K., 1997, Upper Paleocene to Quaternary, surface and near-surface stratigraphy of the Windsor 7.5-minute quadrangle, Aiken and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-90, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face garbled in OCR and read on page images. Map symbols Qal, TQsl, Qcb, Tp, Todb (OCR 'Fodb') and Th (OCR ''Th') read from legend boxes on page images. 'Alamaha Formation' recorded as printed. SCGS drill-hole labels read from the map face on page images (no logs printed; 2-228 is the legend sample only; '6-26' as legible, may be cut by the symbol). Lang Syne Formation known only from two unnamed auger holes. 'Willoughby and others, 1997' is cited but the sheet has no reference list. Exposure marks (x) carry no labels and were not recorded. SUBSURFACE: alluvium thicknesses of 21 ft (2-424) and 20 ft (2-425) and the 2-ft basal Todb pebble zone (2-455) have no depths to place them as surfaces.
